description: A mining company has available a total of 100 square miles of mining sites and considering the use of two mining techniques: heap leaching and vat leaching. For each square mile of land, heap leaching technique can have a daily production of 3 tons of rare earth oxide per square miles but it also creates 8 tons of polluted wastewater and requires 10 extraction machines. On the other hand, vat leaching technique produces 5 tons of rare earth oxide per square miles per day while creating 17 tons of polluted wastewater and requiring 20 extraction machines. There are 100 machines available and due to environmental regulations, the amount of polluted wastewater must be at most 90 tons daily. Find the proportion of lands that use each mining technique in order to maximize the daily production of rare earth oxide.

TotalLand.definition: Total land available for mining in square miles

TotalMachines.definition: Total number of extraction machines available

MaxWastewater.definition: Maximum allowed polluted wastewater per day in tons

ProductionRate.definition: Daily production of rare earth oxide per square mile for each mining technique

WastewaterRate.definition: Daily polluted wastewater created per square mile for each mining technique

MachinesRequired.definition: Number of extraction machines required per square mile for each mining technique

objective.description: "Maximize the total daily production of rare earth oxide from the mining sites"

constraints.description: The total number of extraction machines used across all mining techniques must not exceed TotalMachines
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(MachinesRequired[t] * LandUsed[t] for t in range(NumTechniques)) 
    <= TotalMachines
)

constraints.description: The total amount of polluted wastewater produced per day across all mining techniques must not exceed MaxWastewater
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(WastewaterRate[t] * LandUsed[t] for t in range(NumTechniques)) 
    <= MaxWastewater
)

constraints.description: The land allocated to each mining technique must be non-negative

LandUsed.definition: Amount of land in square miles allocated to each mining technique
